messages:
maya patel: Quick flag — noticed a surge in onboarding nudges after the mass CSV import this morning. Looks like accounts without import_date are being treated as 'stale' and immediately get onboarding playbooks. :confused:
jordan wu: Oof. Do we know which rule is matching? sampler or playbook trigger?
maya patel: sampler. It defaults last_touch to epoch when null, which then triggers the low healthscore path. Sampler logs show repeated re-evals for same account set. Example log: ```INFO sampler run=2024-11-20T08:12:03Z accounts=4120 missing_last_touch=612```
samir rao: Short-term mitigation: add a grace_window to playbook triggers (suggest 7d) and skip playbook firing for imported accounts within that window. Low-risk change and reversible via admin toggle.
leah o'neill: I can implement the admin toggle in the playbook admin UI and add the config flag. That way CS can opt-in/out without a deploy. Will add a migration to backfill import_date too.
jordan wu: We'll also need a backfill for legacy rows that lack import_date. Otherwise they'll still match the sampler logic and cause noise. I can write SQL for a dry-run.
playbook-bot: Alert: onboarding-nudge-volume +2.1% (threshold 1.5%) at 2024-11-20T08:15:11Z — auto-linked incident #8521
maya patel: SQL I tested (dry-run) — fills import_date from earliest event: ```UPDATE accounts a SET import_date = sub.first_seen FROM ( SELECT account_id, MIN(created_at) AS first_seen FROM events GROUP BY account_id ) sub WHERE a.account_id = sub.account_id AND a.import_date IS NULL;```
cs-ops: I can run the dry-run in staging and share diff stats. Drop the real SQL in #cs-ops-runbook when ready.
samir rao: Plan: (1) patch playbook config to include grace_window=7d and admin toggle off by default for imports, (2) run staging dry-run backfill and confirm, (3) add unit tests to sampler to ignore accounts with import_date within grace_window, (4) monitor key metrics for 48h post-change.
leah o'neill: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/cs-playbooks/pull/499 — adds grace_window, admin toggle, docs update, and a migration stub. Please review.
jordan wu: tiny follow-up: add metric dimension imported=true/false on nudge_emitted so we can filter spikes. Should be a quick emitter change and very helpful for post-mortem.
maya patel: Agreed. Add to PR or separate small change. Once staging dry-run looks good we'll flip the toggle and watch dashboards. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
